name: effort-cycle
description: Alt+E steps the effort level up and Alt+Shift+E down, for the main thread or the subagent in view; the footer shows that agent's model and level as they change

includeLow.title: Effort keys: include low
includeLow.description: Alt+E and Alt+Shift+E step through low.

includeMedium.title: Effort keys: include medium
includeMedium.description: Alt+E and Alt+Shift+E step through medium.

includeHigh.title: Effort keys: include high
includeHigh.description: Alt+E and Alt+Shift+E step through high.

includeXhigh.title: Effort keys: include xhigh
includeXhigh.description: Alt+E and Alt+Shift+E step through xhigh.

includeMax.title: Effort keys: include max
includeMax.description: Alt+E and Alt+Shift+E step through max.

mainThreadRow.title: Effort band: row for the main thread
mainThreadRow.description: Adds a row for the main thread to the band above the prompt, above the subagents' rows, with [-] and [+] that step its effort as Alt+E and Alt+Shift+E do.
